name: Coral Button Warrens
introDiscord: The Lunar Current carries you beneath the reef, where dozens of perfectly round coral doors cover the walls like buttons sewn onto stone. Tiny shell mosaics decorate every entrance, and somewhere deeper inside comes the unmistakable clack-clack-clack of very busy claws.
introTwitch: The Lunar Current carries you beneath the reef, where dozens of perfectly round coral doors cover the walls like buttons sewn onto stone. Tiny shell mosaics decorate every entrance, and somewhere deeper inside comes the unmistakable clack-clack-clack of very busy claws.

buttonshell-gate.prompt: Round coral doors cover every wall of the warren. Coral Button Crabs scuttle between them carrying shells, pearls, bottle caps, and anything else vaguely circular. Three low passages lead deeper beneath the reef.

left.message: Beneath a coral shelf, you find one of Shizuki's old field kits surrounded by tiny claw marks. Somehow the crabs have neatly arranged every bottle by size. The surviving remedy is labeled: "Crabgrass salve. The crab objected to the name. Negotiations failed."
left.fullHpMessage: The carefully reorganized field kit can stay exactly where the crabs put it. You're already at full health, and disturbing their filing system feels unwise.

right.message: A Moonkeeper cache has been completely surrounded by little round shells. At first it looks decorative—until you notice the crabs have arranged them by size, color, and shininess. Buried beneath their masterpiece are Star Candies.

forward.message: A Coral Button Crab blocks the passage while proudly holding a perfectly round pearl. You take one step closer. It raises the pearl defensively. You take another. The crab clicks both claws and charges. Apparently you have insulted the button.

crimson-burrows.prompt: The tunnels open into a bustling crimson burrow filled with tiny alcoves. Crabs hurry between them carrying round treasures while discarded objects have been stacked into surprisingly organized piles. Three passages continue through the miniature neighborhood.

left.message: A Coral Button Crab is trying to force a bottle cap into a coral socket that is very clearly too small. You watch. It tries again. You continue watching. Slowly, the crab turns toward you as if this failure is somehow your fault.

right.message: Shizuki's crooked arrow points toward another survival cache—although several tiny shells have been carefully placed around it since she left. Her remedy reads: "Apply generously. Apologize to any buttonshells afterward. They remember."
right.fullHpMessage: You leave Shizuki's remedy untouched. Several crabs are already watching you, and you would rather not discover what an official buttonshell apology involves.

forward.message: You find a moon-shell coffer wedged into the burrow wall. Someone has decorated the lid with pearls, shell chips, and one extremely proud-looking bottle cap. Inside wait Star Candies the crabs apparently considered less interesting than the lid.

clasped-reef.prompt: The innermost warren opens beneath a vaulted reef covered in hundreds of Moonkeeper clasps. Coral Button Crabs have filled nearly every clasp with something round: shells, pearls, polished stones, coins, and several objects whose original purpose has clearly been forgotten. Three tunnels remain open ahead.

left.message: A Fae offering vessel sits perfectly centered inside an enormous decorative clasp. The surrounding crabs have added so many shells that it now resembles a tiny shrine. Fortunately, they seem far more interested in the decorations than the Star Candies inside.

right.message: A Coral Button Crab emerges wearing a Moonkeeper clasp like a tiny crown. Two smaller crabs immediately move aside for it. The crowned crab points one claw at you with startling authority. You have apparently violated a law you were never informed existed.

forward.message: You find Shizuki's abandoned cooking pan surrounded by tiny clawprints. One lonely Berry remains inside beside a note: "Tried making stew. The crabs voted against it by stealing every ingredient except this one. Stew cancelled by democracy." You claim the surviving Berry.

boss-antechamber.name: Crownclasp Chamber
boss-antechamber.prompt: The final tunnel opens into a vast circular chamber covered from floor to ceiling in polished shells, pearls, clasps, and thousands of carefully arranged coral buttons. Dozens of crabs stand perfectly still around a raised mound at the center.

bossPromptDiscord:
One by one, the Coral Button Crabs begin clicking their claws against the stone.

Clack. Clack. Clack.

The mound of shells at the chamber's center shifts. Something enormous rises beneath a crown assembled from Moonkeeper clasps, pearls, and polished coral while every smaller crab immediately scuttles aside.

Use /yes to approach or /no to retreat while the royal clicking is still merely judgmental.
bossPromptTwitch:
One by one, the Coral Button Crabs begin clicking their claws against the stone.

Clack. Clack. Clack.

The mound of shells at the chamber's center shifts. Something enormous rises beneath a crown assembled from Moonkeeper clasps, pearls, and polished coral while every smaller crab immediately scuttles aside.

Use !yes to approach or !no to retreat while the royal clicking is still merely judgmental.
bossRetreatText: You back away from the Crownclasp Chamber. The smaller crabs immediately close ranks around their ruler, clicking suspiciously until you disappear into the tunnels.

boss.revealText: The shell mound erupts as a massive crab rises above the warren, its crown of coral and ancient clasps locked firmly around its shell. The Coral Crown Regent raises both claws, and the entire chamber answers with furious clicking!

completionText: The Coral Crown Regent lowers its battered claws and retreats onto its mound of treasures. For several long seconds, every crab in the chamber stares at you. Then one tiny crab cautiously places a polished shell at your feet. The others immediately resume sorting buttons as though nothing happened. Beyond the Crownclasp Chamber, another route through Moonlit Reef opens between the coral walls.
